Definition: of Hebrew origin (H4899); the Messias (i.e. Mashiach), or Christ:--Messias.
BiblicalUsage: Messias is the Hebrew name for the Anointed One, the Christ. John 1:41 has Andrew find his brother Simon and say, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ, and John 4:25 has the woman of Samaria say, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ, and when He is come, He will tell us all things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name is the confession: Andrew found Him, and the Samaritan woman waited for Him, and both were right.
